  - args: An array of strings representing command-line arguments (not used in this function).

  5. Populate the array T with N integers from input, representing arrival times.
  6. Initialize an integer ansT to 0, representing the time the last person finishes.
  7. Iterate over the array T:
     - For each person i, calculate the time they finish purchasing their ticket as the maximum of their arrival time T[i] and the current ansT, plus A.
     - Update ansT to this calculated finish time.
     - Print the finish time for each person.
